h: Tinubu approves 'world's first' University of Public Relations and Leadership
p: President Tinubu has reportedly approved the creation of a University of Public Relations and Leadership, announced by Vice President Shettima at the World Public Relations Forum in Abuja.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly approved the establishment of what he described as the world's first University of Public Relations and Leadership.

Vice President Kashim Shettima made the announcement on the President's behalf on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, at the 13th World Public Relations Forum in Abuja. Tinubu described the university as a lasting legacy of Nigeria's hosting of the global event.
The institution is expected to focus on specialised education, research and professional training in strategic communication and leadership.
The President acknowledged the roles of the Nigerian Institute of Public Relations and the Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation in bringing the forum to Nigeria.
Details on where the university will be located and when it will open were not included in the reports.
more: It was announced at the World PR Forum in Abuja.
Location and opening date are yet to be announced.
